theorems.name: Submission.slicing_ru_integrableOn_apply
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → ∀ L : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ c : Covector (Eucl P) k, IntegrableOn (fun x => v x c) L μ
